subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope, audit logs & DPA next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope, audit logs & DPA next steps

Hi Alice (and Acme team),

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — good conversation. Quick recap and agreed next steps below so we're all aligned. If I missed anything, flag it and I’ll update.

Key pain points
- Need auditable access and detailed audit logs (per-team ingestion and model invocation events) for regulatory reporting.
- Data retention controls: ability to set retention/auto-delete policies per dataset and per environment (dev/stage/prod).
- DPA & vendor risk: legal needs DPA + pen-test evidence and SOC 2 Type II report to complete procurement validation.

Goals
- Ensure Redwood can provide evidence for: SOC 2 controls, retention/erase flows, and a scoped set of audit logs covering API calls and access.
- Confirm timeline for legal/procurement signoff so you can start a pilot in late April.

What we committed to
1) Share our latest SOC 2 Type II report and a short summary of scope (attached).
2) Provide a one-page retention and deletion playbook for how Redwood handles customer data and retention policies (attached).
3) Provide a short pen-test evidence summary and third-party attestation notes (attached).
4) Schedule a technical follow-up with our infra/security lead (Vivek) to walk through specific log formats and retention APIs next week.

Next steps / timeline
- Marissa: Send SOC 2 report + retention/pen-test summaries (today) — action: COMPLETE (attachments).
- Acme: Legal to review DPA; will share redlines by 2026-03-12.
- Acme Security: Review log sample & confirm fields required by 2026-03-10 so we can prepare an export.
- Schedule technical call: propose 2026-03-09 or 2026-03-10 — Vivek to lead.

Attachments included: SOC2-Report-2025.pdf; redwood-retention-summary.pdf; pen-test-evidence-summary.zip

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Rivera <bob.rivera@acme.com>, security@acme.com, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope, audit logs & DPA next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and fast turnaround. A few clarifications from Legal/Security:

- Legal: will aim to get DPA redlines back by 2026-03-12. If you can include contact for contracts/legal that helps speed review.
- Security: we need a sample CSV/JSON schema of the audit log export (fields: timestamp, user_id, api_key_hash, model_id, prompt_hash, token_count, response_meta) and confirmation that logs are retained for 365 days by default with custom retention available.
- Pen test: can you confirm whether Redwood uses an internal pentest vendor or an external third-party? We prefer third-party attestations where available.

Also, can you share a short example of how deletion requests are handled (API call or console flow) so we can vet for our privacy team?

Would prefer the technical call on 2026-03-10 at 10:00 PT — does that work for Vivek?

Thanks,
Alice Zhang
Head of Security Programs, Acme Corp
alice.zhang@acme.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>, Bob Rivera <bob.rivera@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scope, audit logs & DPA next steps

Thanks Alice — confirms the ask. Quick answers below and I'll bring details to the tech call:

- Audit log schema: we’ll provide a sample JSON export including the fields you listed. We can also deliver a CSV example.
- Retention: default retention is 365 days for production logs; we support custom retention windows and immediate purge for customer-requested erasure (subject to legal holds).
- Pen test: Redwood runs annual third-party pen tests and maintains summary evidence; full engagement reports are available under NDA.
- Deletion flow: we support both API-driven deletion and a console-driven erase workflow. For API: POST /v1/customers/{id}/data-delete with audit trail and token confirmation. For console: Data > Retention > Request deletion (requires 2 approvers for production).

Will prep the log sample + a short runbook before the call and share via Drive link. Confirming 2026-03-10 10:00 PT works for me.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Infra & Security Lead | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ACME follow-up checklist

Marissa — quick internal note to capture next steps on our side (not sent to Acme):

- I’ll draft the DPA contact intro and forward to Legal (target 2026-03-06).
- Vivek: please upload the log sample + runbook to the shared Drive folder and ping Alice.
- Marissa: confirm pilot start date (we suggested end of April) once Legal gives a thumbs up.
- Sales ops: flag deal ACME-2026-01 for priority onboarding if we clear security checklist.

Adding this to the shared hubspot deal notes as well.

Rachel Kim
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
